newsitem.title: USA: Japan must seek domestic, not export, growth-USTR.
newsitem.headline: Japan must seek domestic, not export, growth-USTR.

text.p: Japan should focus on domestic growth, not exports, as the way to economic expansion, U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky said Wednesday, dismayed by Japan's widening trade surplus.
In comments to reporters, Barshefsky said it was disturbing to see statistics that showed a larger trade gap.
"We have told Japan repeatedly that we do not expect to see a significant increase in their trade surplus with the United States," she said.
"We expect Japan will implement policies of domestic-led growth rather than the view, as they seem to be taking, of exporting their way out of recession," Barshefsky said.
